A new, generic way of reading bank SMS.

- **Reads messages by structure, not by template**: the app now splits each SMS into labelled parts ("Amount:", "لدى:", "بطاقة", "من:", "Balance", …) using one shared Arabic/English vocabulary, and decides what each part is from how it looks. It no longer relies on any bank's exact wording, so banks and formats it has never seen are read much better.
- **Cards and accounts found far more often**, including masked numbers like 002-239***-001 and card numbers written before the amount.
- **Correct amounts**: foreign-currency purchases (EUR, GBP, INR, TRY, …), three-decimal amounts and ".99"-style amounts; balances, fees and masked account digits are never taken as the amount.
- **Fewer false transactions**: "Use PIN … to pay" codes, reversed card holds, promotions, limit-change notices and money moved into your own e-wallet are no longer counted.
- Existing transactions are re-read once on first launch after updating. Corrections, labels, merges and card/account answers are kept.

APK: arm64-v8a, built and signed by GitHub Actions.
